caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background with a thin reddish-brown rectangular border. The pitcher is deep reddish-brown in color with reflective highlights indicating a shiny glaze. The body of the pitcher is decorated with a relief of a stylized deer or stag in mid-leap positioned on the upper section, and a reclining animal, possibly a hound, located below. The handle of the pitcher is sculpted to resemble an animal, possibly a fox or hound, with the head forming the top part of the handle and the body curving downward to attach to the pitcher. The pitcher has a wide spout on the left and a sturdy base, all rendered in matching reddish-brown hues with some lighter yellowish and slightly white highlights indicating light reflection and dimension.
title: Crockery Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
